verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw is a law firm, not a software or data-hosting product, so letting a user pick a storage region for their data is a category error for this kind of product. Its Data Protection & Privacy practice advises clients on DPDP/GDPR compliance, but that is legal advice, not a residency-selection capability the firm ships. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm offering user-selectable data storage, so the axis does not apply.
